failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, dynamic-debug-configuration)
failed_jobs.reason: Failure occurs during test fixture teardown ('after each' hook) with EBUSY: resource busy or locked on rmdir of a temp workspace directory on Windows. This is an environmental file-locking race condition unrelated to the PR, which only changes Aspire.Dashboard Razor/CSS files and does not touch the VS Code extension or its E2E fixtures.

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Linux, browser-debugger)
failed_jobs.reason: Three Blazor browser debugger E2E tests failed due to websocket debug proxy launch failure and ~5 minute timeouts waiting for a Blazor WASM debug session to attach. These are timing/connectivity issues in the VS Code extension debugger E2E harness, an area not touched by this PR (which only modifies Aspire.Dashboard Razor/CSS files).
